raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst - Northern Trust Corporation
Jun 2022 - Jun 2026
Roles and Responsibilities:
Support hedge funds and mutual fund and alternative investment structures through accurate accounting, reporting and investor servicing activities.
Managing the daily reconciliation of investment transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.
Analysis of comprehensive financial statements for multiple investment funds, consistently meeting strict reporting deadlines.
Executed precise Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, considering market values, income, and expenses, contributing to reliable and transparent reporting
Actively contributed to the on-time delivery of accurate and compliant financial statements, leading to increased client satisfaction.
Responsible for end-to-end trade processing, including trade booking, validation and reconciliation.
Reviewed and validated pricing of securities including equities, bonds, derivatives, FX and money market instruments.
Maintained investor capital accounts and partner allocations.
Coordinated with custodians, investment managers, auditors, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational queries.
